values.motion: beat 0 is a real ~5 s image-to-video clip made from the film's own B01 still (subtle true motion: fog, water, light, drift; no new objects, nothing that adds a claim), narration over it; beats 1+ unchanged
values.still: house opening: B01 still with the slow zoompan

why: Length pairs 1-2 (11-22/23): short/long 0.75 and 0.88, and avg watch is the same ~4-8 s at 13 s or 35 s. People leave at the opening whatever comes after. Model 11-19: the first pool (~200) is unchanged since 11-04, expansion stopped because in-pool watch fell. Every film since 11-14 opens on a still with a word card. The first 2 s is the remaining untested format lever.
design: within-day pairs, CROSSED with the voice arm so voice reaches n=5 (its pairs 4-5) while opening starts (n=2 each). Voice and opening drawn independently from this seed. Known imbalance in this batch: both motion films drew the 15:45Z slot (slot showed no effect 11-03: 267 vs 250); the next opening batch puts motion at 01:45Z on purpose to balance. Length = house LONG unless the length call (~11-27) says short.
read: plays at first snap >=14h + avg watch s + retention; paired ratio motion/still per day; page daily video views over the posting days. Secondary: 3-s view share if the API exposes it.
call: usual rule: >=1.5x median at n>=5 each -> default; n>=8 each no lead -> tie. Continue pairs (motion slot counterbalanced) to n=5.
harm_check: motion <0.67x still at n>=5 -> drop motion.
spend: image-to-video <=$0.60/clip; whole day <= $5 wall. Do NOT draw OpenRouter beyond TTS (shared balance ~$7 that FBB fallback and small sites ride).
subjects_note: Four subjects chosen by the builder 2026-11-24 BEFORE assignment, ordered by seeded shuffle random.Random('order-opening1'), then mapped in order onto the pre-registered slots (build-opening1.md step 1). All LONG, bleed, stamp, origin fresh, kind anomaly; hooks seeded 'hook-opening1-<name>' (pekingfossils detail, rest place).
motion_model: fal.ai fal-ai/kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-video, 5 s (5.04 s, 1080x1920, 24 fps) from the exact B01 still, $0.35/clip (3 clips made incl. 1 rejected = $1.05). build_short.py slows the clip evenly to fill beat 0 (flordelamar x1.85, pekingfossils x1.28) with framerate= blending; overlay (scrims, kicker, caption) identical to a still beat. Read: flordelamar = clear in-scene motion (swells, ship drifting); pekingfossils = mostly a slow 3D camera push with faint dust (the weaker motion opening) - note this when reading pair 2.
